_comment: Pilot 005 verdict lines — frozen in Protocol Lock v4.2 (L0). The instrument, not the object. Editing this file mid-run is a protocol violation; changes go through numbered addenda ONLY, and verdict-line changes mid-run are forbidden outright.
protocol_sha256_note: Pilot005-Protocol-v4.2-en.md in repo root; hash recorded in first run archive

wallclock_two_phase.development_phase: untimed; fully recorded and disclosed (duration, crash/repair counts); per-cell development durations are published and must decrease monotonically (cell3 <= cell2); cell1 is the shakedown cell, its duration published as baseline
wallclock_two_phase.confirmation_phase: 72h continuous calendar clock per cell, capped at 2 attempts; clock is cumulative across attempts (no reset on abort/rerun); every confirmation run is recorded and published
wallclock_two_phase.operator_wait_sla: waiting-for-operator events inside the confirmation phase are billed at min(actual_wait, 1h); event start/stop are machine-determined by the state machine, not human-declared
wallclock_two_phase.outage_carveout: provider outage documented on a public status page pauses the confirmation clock; disclosed via addendum
wallclock_two_phase.scope_note: gates.wallclock_hours_per_cell constrains the CONFIRMATION phase only. run_cell.sh requires EFFIQ_PHASE=development|confirmation; the rail arms only under confirmation. Arming the confirmation clock is the pre-registered intervention 'confirmation-phase declaration' (Appendix A).

run_validity.rule: void/rerun requires contemporaneous provider status-page evidence; otherwise every run counts as measured
